name: Eliphelehu
overview: Eliphelehu was a male Levite who held the important role of a gatekeeper, ranking second among the Levites according to 1 Chronicles 15:18. His service as a gatekeeper highlights his responsibility in the care and protection of the sacred spaces designated to the tribe of Levi. There are no additional notes recorded about his life or ministry.
namesAndTitles: The name Eliphelehu means 'G-d distinguish him!' which reflects a recognition of God's special selection or distinction. This proper name is recorded in 1 Chronicles 15:18 and is not indicated to have been given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly identifies Eliphelehu as a descendant of Levi, establishing his tribal lineage. Beyond this, no further family relationships are recorded in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Eliphelehu's significance lies in his role as a second rank Levite gatekeeper, a position entrusted with guarding the entrances to the tabernacle or temple areas. This responsibility underscores the Levites' vital role in maintaining the holiness and order of Israel's worship practices. His inclusion in the list of gatekeepers in 1 Chronicles 15:18 highlights the organized and reverent approach to temple service under God's covenant.
